storage_dir.description: Directory where user-specific MUC bookmark files will be stored; must be writable by the ejabberd process.

default_rooms.description: List of default MUC rooms to pre-add to new users' bookmarks.

jid.description: XMPP JID of the MUC room (e.g., 'general@conference.example.com').

nick.description: Nickname to use when joining this room.

autojoin.description: If true, automatically join this room on first login.

name.description: Optional human-readable room name (for UI display). If omitted, the room's published name will be used.

merge_with_existing.description: If true, append default rooms to any existing bookmarks. If false, replace existing bookmarks entirely with the defaults.
